scope: NCP completed_case_plots adapter and ncp_tangent.py RUN_MANIFEST/RESULT producer; no plot rendering or solver execution

checks.reason: RUN schema rec_bianchi.tangent_run.v1 and RESULT schema rec_bianchi.tangent_result.v1 match the producer; nested integration rec.tangent.execution.v1 is checked.

Run hash recomputes sorted-key JSON excluding sha256 exactly as the producer does before adding sha256. source_commit is pinned and source_code_identity equals the complete RUN_MANIFEST object. tangent.npz bytes must match the recorded SHA256.

Outer status COMPLETE/task_exit_code0 and inner status COMPLETED are distinct and checked in their correct layers. Empty checks is explicitly rejected before all(...), preventing empty-dictionary vacuous acceptance.

Axes shape3, n-length x/z, signed observables(n,4), and unscaled signed tangent(n,4,3) match augmented.py outputs. Seed index is last axis and corresponds to S_i,Pm_i,Pr_i. Case axes match both wrapper and integration; signed totals are checked for values and tangent columns.

FAILED/ATTEMPT/claim-only cases have no COMPLETE RESULT and are not plotted. A completed subset can be plotted without claiming all three cases complete; no accepted cases raises NO_COMPLETED_TANGENT_CASES_TO_PLOT. Malformed COMPLETE raises before that case is plotted. Earlier accepted plots may remain as preserved partial output if a later case rejects, but final PLOT_BUILD is not emitted.

The adapter checks n from receipt, monotonic x/z and z(x), but does not require153 nodes, canonical output grid, x interval[0,ln7], or redshift interval[20,2]. A short declared COMPLETED input can pass these checks despite the full-window NCP contract.

findings.target: completed_case_plots after count and shape validation
findings.impact: The axis uses actual z values, so it does not fabricate endpoint labels. However, short completed data are accepted by a path intended for the fixed153-node z20to2 NCP delivery.
findings.minimum_fix: Require count153; compare x to the fixed121+32 grid; compare receipt x_interval and redshift_interval to the frozen endpoints with a small absolute rounding tolerance. Keep the plotter solver-free.

limits: This is static schema/provenance consistency review, not remote execution attestation.
Default local diagnostic layout and visual legends are outside this review.
Physical HOLD/global convergence NOT_RUN/production NOT_APPROVED remain.
